name: Ladenburger Weihnachtsmarkt
description: small town Christmas market among half-timbered houses on the Roman-founded old town square
dateNote: four Advent weekends Fri-Sun: 27-29 Nov, 4-6, 11-13, 18-20 Dec
details:
The Christmas market of Ladenburg on the Marktplatz of the old town, with the stalls in front of half-timbered houses. Open on all four Advent weekends, Friday to Sunday.

Opening Fri 27 Nov 18:00 by the mayor with the Stadtkapelle; Sun 6 Dec from 14:00 St. Nicholas; Sun 13 Dec from 11:00 Garango breakfast with the Polizeiorchester Mannheim; Sun 20 Dec 15-17 stories for children. Hours Fri 18-21, Sat 14-20, Sun 12-20, food stalls until 21. Free entry.
